features.cdr: Search and play call records from the Core Cluster and Edge PBX.
features.cc_campaigns: Outbound dialer campaigns: enable, ports, lines per port, attempts.
features.cc_agents: Agent skills and competency, one agent at a time or by skill roster.
features.cc_nodes: Live status of the contact-centre nodes.
features.extensions: Reserve and create Edge PBX extensions, browse the directory.
features.systems_sync: Record import, mirror checks and the daily recording backup.
features.logs: Activity logs for syncs, backups and contact-centre changes.
features.health: Host metrics, voice lanes and the hourly self-test.
features.users: Console accounts and directory group mapping. Superadmin only.

connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Where the console reads from and writes to. Secrets are write-only: stored values are never shown again.

core.title: Core
core.description: Directory, telephony APIs and call-record rules.

recordings.title: Call recordings
recordings.description: Where recordings are read from and backed up to.

extensions.title: Extension provisioning
extensions.description: How new extensions are numbered and named.

record_store.title: Record store
record_store.description: The mirror that call records are searched from.

directory.title: Directory (LDAP)
directory.description: Corporate directory used for sign-in and the people picker.

edge_api.title: Edge PBX API
edge_api.description: REST interface of the branch telephony system, used for call records and extensions.

core_admin_api.title: Core Cluster admin API
core_admin_api.description: Admin interface of the Core Cluster, plus the folder where its call-record files are dropped.

transfer_detection.title: Transfer detection
transfer_detection.description: Rules for stitching call legs together and recognising transfers.

voice_archive.title: Voice Archive share
voice_archive.description: Network share that holds the Core Cluster recordings.

edge_recordings_a.title: Edge PBX recordings A
edge_recordings_a.description: Recorder on the first branch system, read when a recording is played or backed up.

edge_recordings_b.title: Edge PBX recordings B
edge_recordings_b.description: Recorder on the second branch system, read when a recording is played or backed up.

backup_target_a.title: Backup target A
backup_target_a.description: File-archive destination for Voice Archive recordings.

backup_target_b.title: Backup target B
backup_target_b.description: File-archive destination for Edge PBX recordings.

backup_schedule.title: Backup schedule
backup_schedule.description: When the recording backup runs: every day or once a week.

extension_provisioning.title: Extension provisioning
extension_provisioning.description: Number range, exceptions and naming used when Edge PBX extensions are created.

contact_centre.title: Contact centre
contact_centre.description: Contact-centre nodes: REST admin, SNMP monitoring, a standby node and the port cap.

record_mirror.title: Record mirror
record_mirror.description: Read-only mirror of the call-record database, synced on an interval.

url.label: Directory URL
url.hint: LDAP or LDAPS address of the corporate directory.

bindDn.label: Bind account (DN)
bindDn.hint: Service account that looks users up.

userFilter.label: User filter
userFilter.hint: How a sign-in name is looked up. {username} is replaced at sign-in.

groupSearchBase.label: Group search base
groupSearchBase.hint: Where groups used for role mapping are searched.

verifyTls.label: Verify the TLS certificate
verifyTls.hint: Turn off only for a node with a self-signed certificate.

dropPath.label: Record drop folder
dropPath.hint: Folder where the Core Cluster drops call-record files for import.

operatorDevicePattern.label: Operator device pattern
operatorDevicePattern.hint: Regular expression for agent device names, so agent legs end a transfer chain.

mergeWindowMinutes.label: Merge window (minutes)
mergeWindowMinutes.hint: Legs of the same call this close together are stitched into one call.

huntPilots.label: Hunt pilot numbers
huntPilots.hint: Comma-separated numbers that redirect to a pool of agents.

retentionDays.label: Retention (days)
retentionDays.hint: Files older than this may be removed from the target.

runAt.label: Start time
runAt.hint: 24-hour time in the schedule time zone, HH:MM.

retryDays.label: Re-check past days
retryDays.hint: How many past days a run re-checks for files that were not copied.

reserved.label: Reserved extensions
reserved.hint: Comma-separated numbers that are never offered.

lockMinutes.label: Reservation lock (minutes)
lockMinutes.hint: How long a reserved extension is held before it is released.

bulkImport.label: Allow bulk import
bulkImport.hint: Lets an administrator create several extensions from a list.

snmpCommunity.label: SNMP community
snmpCommunity.hint: Read-only community the node monitor uses.

maxDedicatedPorts.label: Max dedicated ports
maxDedicatedPorts.hint: Most dedicated ports a non-superadmin may give a campaign. The campaign editor uses this value.

syncIntervalMin.label: Sync interval (minutes)
syncIntervalMin.hint: How often new call records are copied from the mirror.

baseUrl.label: REST base URL
baseUrl.hint: Admin REST endpoint of the primary node.

validation.url: Enter an http:// or https:// address.
validation.ldapUrl: Enter an ldap:// or ldaps:// address.
validation.regex: This is not a valid pattern.
validation.order: The range end must not be lower than the start.
